correctness.rationale: The C7 action is free because each nontrivial rotation acts freely on the 21 graph edges while a matching has at most three. Every simplex orbit is enumerated, giving a genuine CW quotient with counts (3,15,15). The complete 15 relators after contraction of an explicitly verified spanning tree are constructed as boundary paths; exact single-occurrence Tietze substitutions produce one generator with relator exponents -21,0,-42, proving pi1=C21. Exact signed boundary composition and integral homology are checked. H1 by Hurewicz, H2 free by dimension and rank two by Euler characteristic; no extrapolation from finite fields.

value.rationale: The natural transitive seven-cycle on the first classical complete matching complex with order-three H1 torsion defines a canonical free orbit space. Determining the full finite fundamental group, not just its abelianization, identifies a structural interaction of the intrinsic order-three class with the sevenfold covering and informs symmetric matching-complex topology. The exact 21-order cyclic group and the two free second-homology classes are mathematically motivated by the canonical object and symmetry.
